name: @waste/domain
description: Pure, deterministic planning logic (ADR-0002): the route schemes, the map-planning questions, UUIDv7 in ids, the permission vocabulary and the system roles in access/, the closed lists of the Registry (registry/vocabulary), of Planning (planning/vocabulary) and of Resources (resources/vocabulary), which the database reads into its CHECK constraints and the contracts into their z.enum, so the two cannot drift, and Resources' two rules beside its lists: the licence implication (resources/licence) and the fold of a Stock Movement onto a Container Asset State (resources/asset-state). Depends on nothing; no React, Next, MapLibre, browser or Node globals. Ships TypeScript source for bundler and tsx consumers (extensionless imports); src/__tests__/purity.test.ts enforces the boundary.
